# v0.38.4 - 2026-08-23

### Documentation

- **Repo-wide accuracy sweep ahead of the public flip (#239, #215, #242).** A three-agent audit checked every doc claim against the v0.38.3 code. Fixed: the README and product brief now list all 18 box types (holidays was missing) and drop stale version/blocker references; the Phase 7 firmware story corrected in four docs — `firmware/integrated/` is the merged Phase 7 build, what remains is the production-panel port; `DISPLAY.md`'s gray-level table was inverted (renderer is 0=white → 3=black); the design brief's provider, layout-cap, editor-UI, and gifting-flow claims were brought current; `CONNECTIVITY.md` no longer denies the shipped account system or claims a PWA; `API.md` now matches the real endpoints (`?dual=1` mode, scale default 3, structured validation errors, 28-route accounting); RFC status markers reflect what shipped; and the refresh cadence reads 1–3×/day (default 3) everywhere, with the power summaries honestly rescaled — including the public setup guide, which previously understated the default.

### Fixed

- **Root `package.json` description no longer advertises the removed calendar box (#242).** The npm/GitHub-facing description now names only box types that exist.
